ticket.title: An unrecognised ticket risk tier clears every capability ceiling
ticket.description: riskTierIndex() returns 0 for a tier it does not recognise, so a ticket with risk_tier 'high' passes an R0 ceiling as though it were read-only. Example ticket written for this demonstration, not a production ticket.

reported_reason.message_includes: unrecognised tier cleared the R0 ceiling
